snippet.title: SushiCupLegendPromotionTrailer EN
snippet.description:
Buy SushiCup Legend now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3536150/SushiCup_Legend/

You are the SushiCupMaster and pass on the traditional techniques to your apprentices.
You are the SushiCupMaster and you will pass on the traditional techniques to your apprentice.

Learn the Kanji of the theme assigned to the apprentice.
Let's check the Kanji engraved on the SushiCup of the apprentice.
If all the Kanji on the SushiCup are the same as the theme, it is “Good”. Let's have a cup of tea and take a break.
If there is a Kanji on the SushiCup that is not on the theme, it is “Bad”. Let's give them strict instructions.
Check the designated number of SushiCups, and if there is no mistake, you will be promoted to the next stage. Challenge the next stage.
Raise your apprentice to the next level and train him or her to become a full-fledged SushiCup craftsman.
When you accomplish this, your real battle will begin.

Sound Credit
shimtone “SAMRAI Soul"
https://dova-s.jp/bgm/play14350.html
